name: ahrena-engineering-devops
description: GitHub as a delivery platform across AWS, Google Cloud and Azure: least-privilege tokens, pinned actions, OIDC instead of stored cloud keys, no contributor text in a script, no privileged trigger running a fork, nothing sensitive in a pipeline log, deploys approved, serialised and reversible, a timeout on every job; skills to write, review and debug pipelines and plan deployments; and Helios, the DevOps specialist.
